fusions.name: Cliffside Ram
fusions.desc: A headlong ram that deals 16 damage, knocks the target back 3.5 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Stand Gore
fusions.desc: A goring blow that deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to it. It only strikes a target at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Dug Heels
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Planted Hooves
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 8% of your maximum health per stack (48% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
